claim.note: Claim on Devnet was clicked on the Wallet tab (twice). The bridge stops before the review/sign dialog because the configured RPC (https://devnet.helius-rpc.com/, no query string) returns 401. A bare POST getHealth to that host returns 401; https://api.devnet.solana.com returns 200. The client rejects RPC URLs that contain a query string, so a Helius ?api-key= URL would be rejected as RPC_INVALID. Pet stayed a house companion.

claim_retry.note: Hard refresh picked up the new CSP (no Helius). SIWS Confirm reconnected player-a. Both Claim on Devnet clicks disabled the button then failed before any Phantom transaction popup. Console shows TimeoutError (AbortSignal), not a 401. From this environment, direct HTTPS to https://api.devnet.solana.com/ succeeds in about 1.5s (getHealth ok), but the browser egress proxy 127.0.0.1:8791 times out connecting to that host (curl via proxy: connection timed out after 20s). A browser navigation to https://api.devnet.solana.com/ also timed out at 20s. No transaction was submitted.
